dedupe_keys.name: swiss national passenger transport model npvm and national transport models of detec

description: The national transport models of the Swiss Federal Department of the Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications are built by the Federal Office for Spatial Development (ARE) with the Federal Office of Transport and the Federal Roads Office. They include a multimodal base model for passenger traffic by rail and road, the national passenger transport model (NPVM), a national model for goods and an aggregate method for freight. The models compute traffic volumes and predict changes in traffic flows, modal shares and bottlenecks, and are used to evaluate infrastructure projects; cantonal, regional and urban models complement them. The 2010 base state ("2010 - Basiszustand") is published through FORS with DOI 10.23662/FORS-DS-987-1 (2019), and trip matrices for passenger and freight traffic for 2010 and 2020 are listed on the Swiss open data portal. Coverage is Switzerland. Access: the FORS release is open access for research, teaching and other non-commercial purposes; the Transport Outlook 2050 model versions derived from it are PTV Visum files. Caveats: the opendata.swiss pages could not be opened from here, and base models are designed for national, not local accuracy. It supports national network flow and capacity planning, and it underlies the Transport Outlook 2050 model versions catalogued here, alongside PTV Visum.
